citation: Flad, Rowan K. 2018. “Urbanism as technology in early China.” Archaeological Research in Asia 14: 121–134. (Article first available online 2016.) DOI 10.1016/j.ara.2016.09.001.
notes: Peer-reviewed article. Treats urbanism as a technology (assemblage of practices/components); compares early Chinese sites including Sanxingdui, Jinsha, and Yinxu along scale, differentiation, centrality, and performance. Use as scholarly *model* for discussing Sanxingdui urban/ritual integration — not as proof of a specific state type. Year labeled 2018 for journal volume; DOI dated 2016 online.
